company.name: Truora
company.shortDescription: Truora offers a technology paltform to simplify and automate user interactions across digital channels.
company.description: Truora provides identity verification and fraud prevention tools that help businesses validate users and reduce risk in digital interactions. Its platform offers services such as background checks, identity authentication, and phone number verification to support secure onboarding and transactions.

productsAndServices.description: A service that verifies user identity through document validation, facial recognition, and contact verification to prevent fraud and comply with regulations.

productsAndServices.description: An online background check service that accesses national and international criminal, judicial, and penal records to assess user risk.
productsAndServices.name: TruChecks Background Verification

productsAndServices.description: Automated chatbots on WhatsApp that handle customer service, marketing, and sales conversations, enhanced with AI for personalized and scalable interactions.
productsAndServices.name: WhatsApp Chatbots with AI Integration

productsAndServices.description: A digital signature platform that enables the creation, sending, and collection of legally valid electronic signatures through multiple channels.

productsAndServices.description: A connector that integrates WhatsApp Business with HubSpot CRM to automate user interactions and synchronize customer data.
productsAndServices.name: WhatsApp and HubSpot Integration

productsAndServices.description: A virtual scholarship program offering web programming courses for women in Latin America to promote inclusion in technology fields.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $15,000,000, or 80.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,088,092 to $75,000,000, a 18.35x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
